eli: Heads-up: action items from postmortem for 2026-03-12 storage outage are overdue. Owners: @maria, @kevin, @tanya. Please post current status + blockers by EOD. If you need more time, say so.
maria: I have a PR that addresses config drift in autoscaler. Waiting on eng-review. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1423. ETA after review: 48h.
kevin: Working on runbook update. Hitting test flakiness in staging. Will pair with QA tomorrow AM. If that fails, may need to defer to next sprint.
tanya: Need infra approval for extra IAM role changes. Security flagged token scope. Working with sec@ to minimize blast radius. ETA ~3 business days.
oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem templates require the 'owner' field populated. If owners change, update the ticket: https://linear.app/RW/issue/PM-207
maria: tagging @sarah for review — can we get a quick +1 on config change? it's low-risk but touching scaling logic.
sarah: I'll review today. If tests are green, give the +1. Also we need an automated canary for this path — can someone add a follow-on action?
ops-sre: temporary mitigation (throttle heuristic) already deployed to reduce spike risk — monitoring looks okay. We'll keep until PR is live.
eli: Thanks. Can each owner please add an explicit 'blocking' line to the postmortem ticket and set updated ETA. This thread will be used to escalate if we hit the new ETA.
kevin: added test plan to ticket and scheduled pairing with QA for 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. Marking blocker: test flakiness.
tanya: sec confirmed reduced scope. filing infra request now: https://k8s-infra/redwood/req/889. ETA updated.
maria: PR updated per review comments, requesting final review @sarah.
sarah: reviewed and approved. maria, please merge when green. :thumbsup:
maria: merged — rolling out canary now. will post canary metrics in ticket.
eli: great — once canary passes, mark action item as 'resolved' in the postmortem and close the loop. I'll check status tomorrow and sweep any remaining open items.
